name: Sniper
theme: Snipers are the unseen predators of the battlefield, patiently waiting for the moment to strike. They excel in precision shooting, taking down high-value targets, and keeping their location hidden even after an attack. In addition to their deadly aim, Snipers can gather information from afar, guiding their allies with vital intel.

tier_skills.name: Deadeye’s Patience
tier_skills.flavor: The world narrows to a single heartbeat… and then it stops.
tier_skills.humanReadableMechanics: Delay one attack to any point this round. If the target moved since your last turn, that attack gains +2 Fortune.

tier_skills.name: Perfect Kill
tier_skills.flavor: No second shot. No witnesses. No escape.
tier_skills.humanReadableMechanics: Make a single shot with doubled Lethality. If it defeats the target, you remain Hidden. The shot ignores resistance to piercing.

tier_skills.name: One Shot, One Legend
tier_skills.flavor: The tale will spread — of the shot no defence could stop.
tier_skills.humanReadableMechanics: This attack auto-crits once (explodes) and ignores parry, block, and magic shields. On kill, allies gain +2 Fortune on their next attack against any enemy in line of sight. Penetration 5.

1.name: Shadowed Nest
1.flavor: You become part of the terrain, unseen until you choose to reveal yourself.
1.humanReadableMechanics: When combat starts from stealth: your first attack gains +1 Fortune and you remain Hidden if it misses.

1.name: Rangefinder
1.flavor: A quick measure, a subtle calculation — and the arrow flies true.
1.humanReadableMechanics: Ignore the first range penalty tier.

1.name: Low Silhouette
1.flavor: Keep your profile tight and the enemy guessing.
1.humanReadableMechanics: While prone, you gain +1 Guard against ranged attacks.

1.name: Predator’s Calm
1.flavor: No twitch, no breath, only focus.
1.humanReadableMechanics: If you did not move this turn, Aimed Shot costs 1 fewer action.

1.name: Heartseeker
1.flavor: Aim for where life beats hardest.
1.humanReadableMechanics: Add piercing damage. If target’s Risk ≥ 20, also apply Vital (1) wound.

1.name: Camber Shot
1.flavor: An arcing shot to slip over cover.
1.humanReadableMechanics: Your next shot ignores low cover via a high arc/angle.

1.name: Lethal Setup
1.flavor: Time your shot for maximum devastation.
1.humanReadableMechanics: If you spend your whole turn aiming, your next shot gains +2 Lethality.

1.name: Armour Probe
1.flavor: Test the armour, find its weakness.
1.humanReadableMechanics: On hit, reduce target’s piercing resistance by 1 for 2 rounds.

1.name: Mark and Measure
1.flavor: Fix your mark and judge the moment.
1.humanReadableMechanics: Spend 1 action: your next attack this round ignores Guard.

2.name: Vital Mark
2.flavor: A silent promise — this one won’t survive.
2.humanReadableMechanics: Spend 1 action to Mark a target; your next attack this turn gains +1 Lethality.

2.name: Wind Reader
2.flavor: Feel the wind in your bones, and adjust.
2.humanReadableMechanics: Once per encounter, ignore environmental penalties (wind, rain, etc.) for one shot.

2.name: Tag & Report
2.flavor: Eyes on the target, voice in the ear.
2.humanReadableMechanics: Spend 1 action: highlight an enemy; allies get +1 Fortune on their next attack against it.

2.name: Stillness Training
2.flavor: Sometimes the smallest motion is the loudest.
2.humanReadableMechanics: If you didn’t move this round, gain +1 Fortune on ranged attacks.

2.name: Burning Brand
2.flavor: Let the arrow carry the fire.
2.humanReadableMechanics: Add fire damage. If target’s Risk ≥ 20, apply Burning (2).

2.name: Silencing Shot
2.humanReadableMechanics: On hit, target becomes Mute for 2 rounds.

2.name: Weakpoint Scan
2.flavor: Strip away every illusion of defence.
2.humanReadableMechanics: Make a Wits check; on success, your next attack ignores armour.

2.name: Shiver Bolt
2.flavor: Cold creeps in where armour gaps.
2.humanReadableMechanics: Add cold damage; target’s inflexibility is reduced by 2 for 2 rounds (takes less Risk from hits).

2.name: Explosive Tip
2.flavor: Make a statement they can’t ignore.
2.humanReadableMechanics: Add fire damage; enemies within 2 squares of the target take half damage.

3.name: Ghost Relocation
3.flavor: Strike, vanish, relocate — they’ll never pin you down.
3.humanReadableMechanics: After a ranged attack, spend 2 actions to move your full movement without provoking reactions.

3.name: Target Acquisition
3.flavor: Snap to the next mark without hesitation.
3.humanReadableMechanics: Once per turn, your first ranged attack against a new target costs 1 fewer action.

3.name: Spotter’s Lens
3.flavor: Even the smallest twitch betrays them.
3.humanReadableMechanics: Perception range is doubled when using optics.

3.name: Veiled Exit
3.humanReadableMechanics: If you start your turn Hidden, gain +1 Guard until your next turn.

3.name: Piercing Ice
3.humanReadableMechanics: Add cold damage; target’s movement is halved for 2 rounds.

3.name: Disruptive Bolt
3.humanReadableMechanics: Add electric damage; on hit, target becomes Disoriented.

3.name: Armour Breaker
3.humanReadableMechanics: On hit, reduce the target’s Guard by 2 (until repaired/restored).

3.name: Flash Shot
3.humanReadableMechanics: On hit, apply Blind for 1 round.

3.name: Pinion Arrow
3.humanReadableMechanics: Add piercing; target is Immobilised for 1 round.

3.name: Poison Tip
3.flavor: A slow kill is still a kill.
3.humanReadableMechanics: Add poison damage; apply Poisoned (3) lingering.

4.name: Crack the Guard
4.flavor: One shot to shatter their stance.
4.humanReadableMechanics: When attacking a guard-broken target, add +10 effective Risk.

4.name: Piercing Arc
4.flavor: Straight through one, into the next.
4.humanReadableMechanics: Your attack hits one additional enemy in a straight line behind the primary target.

4.name: Pressure Lock
4.humanReadableMechanics: If you hit at maximum range, the target gains +5 Risk.

4.name: Phantom’s Bluff
4.flavor: Confuse them with where you’re not.
4.humanReadableMechanics: After a ranged attack, make a Bluff check to mislead enemies about your position.

4.name: Shadowburst
4.flavor: Snuff the light, own the dark.
4.humanReadableMechanics: Add dark damage; extinguish non-magical light in a 3‑square radius.

4.name: Flame Relay
4.humanReadableMechanics: Add fire damage; the impacted square ignites as burning terrain for 2 rounds.

4.name: Sapping Bolt
4.humanReadableMechanics: On hit, reduce the target’s Resolve by 1 for 1 round.

4.name: Distracting Ricochet
4.flavor: Make them look the wrong way.

4.name: Armour Stress
4.flavor: Make their armour work against them.
4.humanReadableMechanics: On hit, increase the target’s inflexibility by 3 for 1 round (they take more Risk from hits, up to their cap).

4.name: Overdraw
4.flavor: Push the bow — and your body — past its limit.
4.humanReadableMechanics: Increase this attack’s final damage by x1.5; you lose 1 Guard from strain.

5.name: Breath Control
5.flavor: One breath out, one arrow loosed.
5.humanReadableMechanics: Once per encounter, gain +3 Fortune on an aimed shot; you can take no other actions that turn.

5.name: Double Tap
5.flavor: Two quick hits, one killing motion.
5.humanReadableMechanics: Spend +1 action to fire twice at the same target; combine damage for Risk effects.

5.name: Patience of the Hunter
5.flavor: Wait until their fate is certain.
5.humanReadableMechanics: Skip attacking to gain +1 Fortune on your next attack within 2 rounds.

5.name: Marked for Death
5.flavor: You’re already dead — you just don’t know it yet.
5.humanReadableMechanics: Spend 1 action to Mark a target; if it’s defeated this turn, you regain 2 actions.

5.name: Bleedout Arrow
5.flavor: One wound to drain them dry.
5.humanReadableMechanics: Add slashing damage; if target’s Risk ≥ 20, apply Bleed (2).

5.name: Corrupting Shaft
5.humanReadableMechanics: Add death damage; apply Decay (1) lingering.

5.name: Nervebreaker
5.flavor: Pain can be more final than death.
5.humanReadableMechanics: Add pain damage; apply Suffering (2) lingering.

5.name: Binding Wire
5.humanReadableMechanics: On hit, target is Grabbed for 1 round.

5.name: Armour Null
5.flavor: For this shot, their armour may as well be paper.
5.humanReadableMechanics: This attack treats all resistances as 0 (immunities still apply).

5.name: Last Light
5.flavor: A burning arrow of hope — or doom.
5.humanReadableMechanics: Add light damage; deal double damage to dark-aligned targets.
